strings: r_c0 fusses over m_c as {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/loll/lolls} {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head in the den, too weak from pain and fever to even eat the provided herbs on their own.
m_c can barely raise {PRONOUN/m_c/self} from the nest to go for herbs, a deep ache dragging {PRONOUN/m_c/object} back down.
The pain rolls over {PRONOUN/m_c/object}, waves and waves of it making m_c wish that {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} had somehow avoided the rat bite.
